name: write_style_guide
description: Replace the current run's style guide document with the given content. The write is a full overwrite: the previous style guide is discarded, so always pass the complete document rather than a patch. The style guide location is fixed by the run; there is no path parameter.

detailed: Writes a run's style guide document.
tool {participantRole} is writing the style guide

content.description: The complete style guide document. It replaces the previous style guide in full.
